upstream.scope: Port the full three.js logic to C++; replace the rendering backend with Vulkan. Partial modules are not completion.

nativeDependencies.name: Unicode NFC data
nativeDependencies.purpose: Native NFC normalization of LoadingManager URLs with the pinned Node oracle Unicode version; no JavaScript engine

nativeDependencies.name: V8 fdlibm sin/acos
nativeDependencies.license: Sun fdlibm notice and V8 BSD-3-Clause, retained in implementation
nativeDependencies.purpose: Native binary64 arithmetic for quaternion interpolation and observable animation callbacks; no JavaScript engine

nativeDependencies.name: V8 Math.pow entry point
nativeDependencies.purpose: Native Math.pow semantics for addon curve formulas: the pinned Node release enables V8's --use-std-math-pow default, so ECMAScript NaN/infinity cases, y === 2 as x * x and y === 0.5 as sqrt( x + 0 ) are explicit and every other input reaches the platform std::pow; no JavaScript engine

nativeDependencies.name: V8 TimSort
nativeDependencies.license: V8 BSD-3-Clause and Python license chain, retained in src/core/ArraySort.LICENSE
nativeDependencies.purpose: Native stable sorting with the pinned oracle comparator order, including NaN and inconsistent comparators; no JavaScript engine

nativeDependencies.name: Unicode default uppercase data
nativeDependencies.purpose: Native default full uppercase conversion of UTF-16 strings, preserving lone surrogates; no JavaScript engine

nativeDependencies.name: Khronos SPIRV-Reflect
nativeDependencies.purpose: Owned native SPIR-V entry-point interface and descriptor reflection; no JavaScript engine

nativeDependencies.name: Khronos glslang native ESSL frontend fork
nativeDependencies.purpose: Original ESSL parse/link and native AST-to-SPIR-V compilation; three-file frontend fork disclosed in dependency lock

nativeDependencies.name: Khronos SPIRV-Tools validator
nativeDependencies.purpose: Independent validation of native ESSL SPIR-V; two-file CMake-only patch keeps generated Python caches outside source trees

nativeDependencies.name: Khronos SPIRV-Headers
nativeDependencies.purpose: Pinned SPIR-V definitions used to source-build the validator
